nevermin.view.explorer.name: NeverMIN
nevermin.viewsWelcome:
Choose how NeverMIN may use this workspace:
[Private — local Ollama only](command:nevermin.setPrivacyPrivate)
[Public — cloud LLM allowed](command:nevermin.setPrivacyPublic)

Then open a folder and run analysis from the sidebar:
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

Privacy mode, file selection, Structure, and Git History live in the NeverMIN sidebar.
nevermin.language.markdownDescription:
Language for the NeverMIN sidebar, webviews, and LLM answers.

You can also change this from the sidebar **Settings**, or run `NeverMIN: Pilih Bahasa / Choose Language`.
nevermin.provider.markdownDescription:
Active LLM provider.

Privacy mode is chosen once per workspace in the sidebar (not a setting here):
- **Private** — locked to Ollama; cloud API keys are cleared
- **Public** — cloud providers allowed (Gemini, OpenAI, …). Pick a cloud provider, then run `NeverMIN: Simpan API Key`

You can also change the provider from sidebar **Settings**.
nevermin.provider.enum.ollama: Ollama (local, no API key) — required in Private mode
nevermin.model.markdownDescription:
LLM model id. Leave empty to use the provider default (for example Ollama `llama3.2`, Gemini `gemini-flash-latest`).

For Ollama, prefer `NeverMIN: Pilih Model Ollama` (lists installed / loaded models).

The model must match the active provider. Incompatible or retired ids are replaced with the provider default.
nevermin.temperature.markdownDescription: LLM sampling temperature (0 = more deterministic). Used for Explain, insights narrative, node summaries, contribution gaps, and related LLM calls.
nevermin.ollamaBaseUrl.markdownDescripti:
OpenAI-compatible base URL for Ollama.

Default: `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`. NeverMIN strips `/v1` when calling native Ollama APIs (`/api/tags`, `/api/ps`).
nevermin.ollamaNumCtx.markdownDescriptio:
Ollama context window (`num_ctx`).

Small models often default to 4096 tokens; large Explain prompts can exceed that (`exceed_context_size`). Raise to `8192` or `16384` if you have enough RAM/VRAM; lower it if Ollama runs out of memory.
nevermin.maxAnalysisFiles.markdownDescri:
Max files per analysis run (whole repo or files checked under sidebar **Select Files**).

Analysis builds the code graph, Structure tree, insights, and diagrams. Git History is a separate local `git` scan.
